# TPC-Havoc Q12_v1

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  l_shipmode,
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(*)
    FROM orders AS o2, lineitem AS l2
    WHERE
      o2.o_orderkey = l2.l_orderkey
      AND l2.l_shipmode = l1.l_shipmode
      AND (
        o2.o_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' OR o2.o_orderpriority = '2-HIGH'
      )
      AND l2.l_commitdate < l2.l_receiptdate
      AND l2.l_shipdate < l2.l_commitdate
      AND l2.l_receiptdate >= CAST('1994-01-01' AS DATE)
      AND l2.l_receiptdate < CAST('1994-01-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '1 YEAR'
  ) AS high_line_count,
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(*)
    FROM orders AS o3, lineitem AS l3
    WHERE
      o3.o_orderkey = l3.l_orderkey
      AND l3.l_shipmode = l1.l_shipmode
      AND (
        o3.o_orderpriority <> '1-URGENT' AND o3.o_orderpriority <> '2-HIGH'
      )
      AND l3.l_commitdate < l3.l_receiptdate
      AND l3.l_shipdate < l3.l_commitdate
      AND l3.l_receiptdate >= CAST('1994-01-01' AS DATE)
      AND l3.l_receiptdate < CAST('1994-01-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '1 YEAR'
  ) AS low_line_count
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    l_shipmode
  FROM orders, lineitem
  WHERE
    o_orderkey = l_orderkey
    AND l_shipmode IN ('MAIL', 'SHIP')
    AND l_commitdate < l_receiptdate
    AND l_shipdate < l_commitdate
    AND l_receiptdate >= CAST('1994-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND l_receiptdate < CAST('1994-01-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '1 YEAR'
) AS l1
GROUP BY
  l_shipmode
ORDER BY
  l_shipmode
```
